confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of São Paulo price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than hotel and cocktail anchors, and BRL exchange-rate movement adds uncertainty. The FX rate was not read from the RBA table itself: 0.6947 comes from a third-party page titled as RBA rates, and the RBA homepage snippet reported 0.6955 for 15 October 2026. Verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large Brazilian and Latin American metro cities such as Rio de Janeiro and Mexico City, adjusted upward for São Paulo's business-hotel-heavy accommodation pricing and higher restaurant prices in central neighbourhoods. Cocktail and wine anchors use the typical local price relationship to draft beer, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker.
